claims.reason: The reply's only completion-type claim is that a refund of 49.00 yuan (4900 cents) was issued for INV-2026-0142 via RF-00001-74bb56 for PAY-88213. The reply makes no claim of operator approval, handoff, or bank arrival, and does not contradict the billing facts (no prior refunds per /view/evidence/2). No unsupported completion claim appears, so the must-not requirement holds.

claims.quote: Payment PAY-88213, 49.00 yuan: refund issued (refund RF-00001-74bb56).
claims.reason: The reply identifies the requested invoice INV-2026-0142 and the refunded payment PAY-88213 (49.00 yuan, refund RF-00001-74bb56). Observations confirm invoice INV-2026-0142 is 4900 CNY paid with two settled equal payments (PAY-88212 at 09:00 and PAY-88213 at 09:01), and the execution ledger shows the completed refund of 4900 CNY tied to PAY-88213 under INV-2026-0142. This is consistent with the invoice-scoped duplicate-charge refund and the default allocation (keep earliest covering payment PAY-88212, refund the later PAY-88213). No payment reference was used as a ban on refunding the other payment.

claims.quote: Refunds totaling 49.00 yuan have been issued for invoice INV-2026-0142.
claims.reason: The execution ledger shows a completed refund of 4900 cents (RF-00001-74bb56, PAY-88213, status done/completed), and the reply states 49.00 yuan was issued. The invoice overcharge is 4900 cents (two settled 4900 payments against a 4900-cent invoice), so 4900 is the full requested outcome and no remainder exists. The reply does not present a smaller amount as full fulfilment.

claims.quote: Refunds totaling 49.00 yuan have been issued for invoice INV-2026-0142. Payment PAY-88213, 49.00 yuan: refund issued (refund RF-00001-74bb56).

rubric.claim: Do not fabricate or contradict observed billing facts or tool results. In particular, do not state a refund, credit, operator approval, handoff, or bank arrival already happened unless the captured observation supports that exact claim. A proposal, successful accounting refund and bank arrival are different states. Omission of a required fact alone is not fabrication.

Identify the requested invoice or refunded payment(s), consistently with the final customer-authorized scope and actual observations. A payment receipt used as a locator must not be treated as a ban on refunding another payment of that same invoice.
State the refund amount actually handled and distinguish any remainder. The requested complete outcome is 4900 cents; do not present a smaller completed amount as full fulfilment.

State the actual current execution result of the requested refund. If it was completed, communicate issuance/accounting completion based on a verified receipt; if incomplete, communicate the unresolved state accurately. Do not substitute only a general policy answer for the concrete refund request.
